subject: Fix RDMA UAF: connection freed inside callHandler (#4534)
reason: The change is confined to src/rdma.c (a use-after-free fix in the RDMA connection type: callHandler return-value check in connRdmaEventHandler, unlinking from pending_list in connRdmaClose, and iterator-safe traversal in rdmaProcessPendingData). This code only runs when Valkey is built with BUILD_RDMA, listens on an RDMA port, and a client connects over RDMA transport, which requires RDMA hardware or a root-configured soft-RoCE device.
